mechanism.old_bug: Unclassified RuntimeError/AssertionError from actual provider HTTP, or a lost typed receipt after actual HTTP, escaped the narrow gateway catch and left the worker initial uncalled0/0 unchanged after its own dispatch commit.
mechanism.gateway_fix: Initialize actual attempted flag before building the request; unexpected exceptions are converted to a sanitized typed error retaining independently received nullable counts and actual attempted flag. Known failures before HTTP remain known uncalled0/0.
mechanism.worker_fix: If this call observed its own dispatch commit but received no typed gateway receipt, record WORKER_INTERRUPTED with input/output/model_call_attempted allNone; do not retain initial0/0. Before a dispatch commit the known uncalled path remains unchanged.
